text:
maria: FYI we're scheduling an infra apply for release v2.3 — target window 02:00 UTC. Changes: provider bump, IAM role rotation, two route-table updates. Need tight coordination and a manual gate between IAM and the traffic shift.

sam: copy. can we outline exact sequence so deploybot can gate steps?

maria: sequence: 1) pin provider in root module, 2) apply IAM (module.iam), 3) wait 6m for caches, 4) apply route_add (non-disruptive), 5) 15m 20% canary, 6) route_shift (module.route_shift), 7) smoke tests + release.

lee: oncall available. set paging to @oncall if anything classified sev2 or higher. i'll watch SLOs.

kevin: prefer splitting network changes into two separate TF targets to minimize blast radius (route_add vs route_shift). also record tfstate snapshot before route_shift.

maria: yes, will take tfstate snapshot and store at S3://tfstate/snapshots/infra-v2.3-preapply.tfstate. I'll also record the git sha.

deploybot: queued plan 9054 for repo infra/terraform branch release/v2.3. Jobs created: plan-9054, apply-9055 (module.iam), apply-9056 (module.route_add), apply-9057 (module.route_shift). Manual holds set between apply-9055 -> apply-9056 and apply-9056 -> apply-9057. Reply with `approve <job-id>` to continue.

anya: security check: did we run the IAM linter and service-account diff? who can paste the diff output?

maria: ran iam-lint; no new iam:PassRole or wildcard principals. snippet: ```iam-diff --base main.json --candidate pr.json => no privilege escalation```

sam: I'll run `terraform apply -target=module.iam` when window opens and paste the short output.

opsbot: reminder: token-cache TTL is 5m for our client SDKs. plan for a waiting period after IAM rotation to avoid auth flakiness.

sam: apply-9055 output: `Apply complete: 4 added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed`  roles rotated, no errors.

maria: good. pausing 6m for caches to propagate.

deploybot: job apply-9056 (module.route_add) is waiting for `approve 9056`.

lee: after route_add, i'll enable 20% canary via LB weights and watch `/health` and `/metrics`. if error-rate > 1.5% or p95 > 1.15x baseline, we abort.

kevin: pre-stage rollback steps in the runbook: 1) set LB weights back to 100% old, 2) `git revert <sha>` && `terraform apply -target=module.route_shift`, 3) restore tfstate from snapshot if required. also include KMS key and S3 path in runbook.

maria: rollback snippet for quick copy:
```bash
# block new route traffic
kubectl annotate svc my-api traffic-weight=0 --overwrite
# revert route shift via terraform
git checkout <preapply-sha> && terraform apply -auto-approve -target=module.route_shift
# restore tfstate if Terraform errors:
aws s3 cp s3://tfstate/snapshots/infra-v2.3-preapply.tfstate ./terraform.tfstate
```

anya: i'll validate S3/KMS permissions now and run a dry restore in staging. will post results.

sam: route_add applied: `Apply complete: 2 added, 1 changed`  good to start canary.

lee: turning on 20% canary. watching logs and tracer. ping me if any anomalies.

maria: confirm provider pinned?

sam: provider pinned to 1.2.3 in root module and lockfile updated. validation passed locally.

deploybot: job apply-9057 (module.route_shift) queued. Manual hold active. Reply `approve 9057` to proceed.

lee: canary stable for 18m. latency and error-rate normal. proceed when ready.

maria: approve 9057.

deploybot: apply-9057 started by sam. logs:
```
applying module.route_shift...
module.route_shift.aws_route.example: Modifying... [id=rtb-9abc]
Apply complete: 0 added, 2 changed, 0 destroyed
```

sam: smoke tests: `curl -sS https://api.prod/health | jq .status` => "ok". No 5xx during canary period.

kevin: saw a brief 503s at t+90s during route_shift, looks transient. capture timing for postmortem.

maria: publishing release note: "v2.3 infra: provider bump pinned to 1.2.3; IAM role rotations; staged route updates with canary; no privilege increases detected."

lee: watching extra for 2 hours. alert thresholds in place: error-rate > 2% or p95 > 1.2x baseline triggers paging.

anya: S3/KMS restore dry-run successful in staging. access validated.

maria: thanks everyone. will update playbook with job ids (9054-9057) and the snippets above. closing thread. ✅
